0250_[99000/998788/992266 White : VIP] [09/27/26]The 每周一奖金＋大额奖金 table header is not enclosed within a border.

data.text:
Fixed in MR !395 (branch fix/vip-table-header-band-inset into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

About the border: the blue box in the Figma reference is Figma's selection highlight. It is the outline Figma draws around a selected layer, together with its 352 × 40 size label. It is not part of the design. With nothing selected, the header in Figma is a plain light-grey bar with no outline, and iOS and Web draw none either. See the attached "Figma table unselected - header has no border.png".

What was actually wrong on Android: the grey header bar ran all the way to the edges of the white table card and sat flush against its top. That grey is also the page background colour, so the bar blended into the page and the header looked like it was outside the table. It now sits inside the white card, with an 11dp white margin on the top and both sides, and it is exactly as wide as the row lines below it, as in the Figma design. No border was added.

Verified:
- Samsung S24 (Android 15), before and after builds of the same page. See the attached "Android before vs after - header band inside the card.png".
- Rendered layouts at 360dp and 390dp screen widths, with normal and large font sizes.
- Column positions and header height are unchanged.

Not verified: an Oppo A57 on Android 14 specifically.

Note: since your build (v8.9.26.1.1), the table title and columns have changed. It now reads 每周奖金 + 每月奖金, with 升级奖励 / 每周奖金 / 每月奖金 columns, so the retest build will look different from your screenshot.

Please re-test once the MR is merged.

0174_[99000/998788/992266 White : VIP] [9/23/2026] -Incorrect Profile Briefly Appears and Disappears When Opening VIP Section

data.text:
Fixed in MR !385 (branch fix/vip-opens-without-profile-ghost into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

Cause: opening VIP used a slow fade between the two screens, so for a moment the Profile page showed through the VIP page. While VIP was still loading, its header showed the default avatar picture next to an empty name, and the phone paused briefly while it drew the VIP data, which froze that mixed picture on screen. That mix is the "other profile" in the recording.

Fix: VIP now opens and closes instantly, with no fade. Its header shows your own avatar, name, VIP level and points from the start, with a plain grey circle for the first moment and never another person's picture.

Verified on a Samsung S24 (Android 15), same account, before and after: the mixed frames are gone on every VIP open and on back, and other screens keep their usual transition.
Not verified: the Redmi 9T on Android 12, and the 998788 and 992266 builds (they use the same code).

Please re-test on the Redmi 9T once the MR is merged and in a build.

0165_[998788 White : SEARCH] [09/23/2026] Error message is displayed in the User tab of the Search page

data.text:
Fixed in MR !384 (branch fix/search-raw-server-error-text into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

Cause: on 998788 the backend's user search fails for every keyword with a database error (Error 1054 (42S22): Unknown column 'm.live_user_id_binary' in 'order clause'). The Android app showed any backend message word for word, so that raw database error appeared on the 用户 tab, and also in the people section of the 综合 tab.

Fix: search now does what iOS does when the backend rejects a search. The 用户 tab shows the empty state (未找到结果 / 请尝试其他关键词) with no error text, and on the 综合 tab the empty user section is hidden while the other results still show. A network failure (no connection, timeout) still shows an error with 重试. The app also no longer displays backend database/crash text on other screens; normal backend messages (for example 余额不足) still show as before.

Backend: user search itself still fails on the 998788 server until the backend adds the missing column/index there (the 992266 and 99000 servers return results for the same search). Until then the 用户 tab shows 未找到结果 for every search, like iOS does today; once the backend is fixed it will list the matching users as expected.

Verified: 998788 debug build on an Android 12 emulator while the backend was still failing. The 用户 tab shows 未找到结果 with no error and no database text, and the 综合 tab shows its other results without the user section.
Not verified: a real vivo / Android 12 phone.

Please re-test after the merge, and again for the expected user results once the backend fix is in.

data.text:
Fixed in MR !382 (branch fix/pending-turnover-amount-size into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

Cause: each row on the Pending Barcode Completion page had a fixed height. At the normal font size, the 入账金额 label left too little room under it, so the entry amount shrank itself to its 10sp minimum instead of the 13sp in Figma. Phones set to a smaller font size still had room, which is why it did not show on every device.

Fix: the row heights are now minimums, so the amount always has room for its 13sp design size. The same row is used in the 待完成打码 preview on the Withdraw page, so that is fixed too. At the normal font size each row is about 3dp taller than before; at smaller font sizes nothing changes.

Verified on the emulator at 360dp (the Oppo A57's width) with the normal font size, before vs after on the same 8 records: every entry amount went from about 10sp to about 13sp, on both the full list and the Withdraw page preview, with nothing overlapping. At the largest font size the amount and the time are no longer cut off.

Not verified: an Oppo / ColorOS device. Separate and unchanged by this fix: at the largest font size the "还需" text on the progress line is still cut at the bottom, the same as before.

Please re-test on the Oppo A57 once the MR is merged.

data.text:
Fixed in MR !381 (branch fix/account-details-filter-label-wrap into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

Cause: the filter option's label had no text alignment, so when a long label wrapped onto a second line, both lines started from the left edge instead of the centre. The label also used a tall 24sp line height, so two lines did not fit inside the option and the second line was cut off at the bottom border.

Fix: every line of the label is now centred, the label takes at most two lines (a longer one ends with "…"), and a compact line height keeps both lines inside the option. The option size, font size and where labels break are unchanged.

Verified on the emulator at 360dp with the normal font size, before vs after on the same account (998788): all 63 type options were measured. Every wrapped label (One Piece大宝藏, 开启每日充值活动费用, 每日累计打码活动, 购买主播陪聊服务, 进阶礼包差额彩金, 阶梯充值打码彩金) is centred on both lines with nothing touching the border. The selected (bold) option and the date filter were also checked.

Not verified: a real Oppo A57 / Android 14, and the 992266 build (same code). Please retest on your device.

Step by Step:

1. Install and open Zhubo app
2. Log in as guest
3. Open the **Profile / Me** page.
4. Tap **Promotion**.
5. Tap **Invite Now**.
6. In the **Share Invitation** modal, tap **More Methods** repeatedly in quick succession.
7. Observe the Android system Share panel.
8. Tap **Cancel** to close the Share panel.
9. Observe that another Share panel is still displayed.
10. Continue tapping **Cancel** until all opened Share panels are closed.

‌

### Actual Result

- Each tap on **More Methods** triggers a new Android system Share panel. Multiple Share panels are stacked based on the number of times the button was tapped, requiring the user to tap **Cancel** multiple times to close all opened panels.
  ‌

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6ab88cb9e0387dafef3cdae9/attachments/6abb4bcade4959cdb8c86395/previews/6abb4bcade4959cdb8c8639c/download/image.webp)

### Expected Result

- Tapping **More Methods** should open only **one** Android system Share panel. Additional taps should be ignored while the Share panel is being opened or is already displayed.

data.text:
Fixed in MR !380 (branch fix/withdrawal-record-filter-chevron into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

Cause: the Date and Withdrawal Status filters already knew when their dropdown was open, but only used that to darken the border. The arrow itself was always drawn pointing down.

Fix: each filter's arrow now turns to point up while its own dropdown is open and back down when it closes, with the same short animation as the Betting Record date filter and the bank card selector on the Withdraw page. Only the open filter's arrow turns. Nothing else on the page changed.

Verified on an Android emulator with the same account: on build 8.9.28.1.1 neither arrow turned in any of 7 openings. With the fix, the open filter's arrow points up while the other stays down, and both point down again after closing by tapping the same filter, choosing an option, tapping the dimmed area, or switching to the other filter (15 of 15 checks).

Not verified: a real Oppo device on Android 14 (emulator only). Please retest on the next build that includes MR !380.

On the Android withdrawal records screen, the bank/wallet icon is displayed as a rounded square instead of the circle specified in Figma. The status "提现中" uses orange text on a light orange badge. 2. Then select the profile tab from menu section
3. Then select the withdraw icon button.
4. Create a withdrawal request (e.g. 1.00 to 波币).
5. Open the withdrawal records screen in the Android app.
6. Compare the icon, status, title and label with the Figma design.

Results:

- The 波币 icon is a rounded square.
- The status shows "提现中" in orange on a light orange badge.
- The title reads "记录".
- The item label reads "至 波币".

Expectations:

- The icon is clipped to a circle at the Figma size.
- The status text and badge color come from the shared status mapping and match Web and iOS.
- The title reads "提现记录".
- The item label matches the confirmed Figma copy ("提款至{name}").
- The page looks the same as the Figma design and the other platforms.

data.text:
Fixed in MR !378 (branch fix/olivine-invite-return-cell-clipping into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

Cause: the level ranges and reward amounts in the three VIP特邀回归 tables were drawn in boxes narrower than the table cells, with extra letter spacing. Anything too long wrapped onto a second line that was never shown, so VIP10 - VIP13 appeared as "VIP10 -". The same thing made the four-digit rewards lose their 元 on some phones (1888, 3888, 8888).

Fix: each value now uses the full width of its table cell, with the same letter spacing as Figma, and never wraps. If a phone's font is still too wide, the whole column shrinks slightly instead of cutting a value. Nothing else on the page changed.

Verified on the Android test phone (Samsung, 360dp): on build 8.9.25.1.1 the ranges showed as "VIP10 -", "VIP14 -", "VIP18 -", "VIP23 -" and 1888 / 3888 / 8888 had no 元. With the fix, every value in all three tables shows in full: VIP10 - VIP13 through VIP23 - VIP30, and 1888元, 3888元, 8888元. Not tested on an Oppo A57.

Please re-test on the next build that includes this fix.

data.text:
Fixed in MR !377 (branch fix/referral-share-sheet-title into main-v4), awaiting review and merge.

Cause: the share pop-up's title text was set to 邀请好友 in the app since the Referral Center was first built, so it never matched the 分享邀请 title in Figma. iOS already shows 分享邀请.

Fix: the pop-up title now reads 分享邀请. Nothing else in the pop-up changed.

Verified on the Android emulator with the 998788 build: the title shows 分享邀请, and the rest of the pop-up is identical to before. Not verified on a real device or on Android 11 (the Vivo 1904 in the report).

Note: the share option labels (复制推广链接 / 二维码海报) are handled in the separate share-options ticket, and the 我的推广码 label was not part of this report, so both are unchanged here.

Please re-test once the MR is merged.

**Steps:**

- Install and Open the app
- Login in any method
- Go to Message
- Initiate a video call
- Answer the call on the Receiver device.
- Once the call is connected, turn off the camera.
- Check the active call interface on both the Caller and Receiver devices.
- Compare the displayed UI with the expected `接通-关闭摄像头-双方界面一样` layout.

**Result**

The current build displays a different interface on both the Caller and Receiver sides:

1. **Missing Top Action Icons**
   - Magic Wand/Filter and Camera Switch icons are missing from the upper-right area.
2. **Incorrect Video and Avatar Layout**
   - A small camera-off icon box is displayed in the upper-right instead of the expected floating video preview window.
   - The expected separate center Avatar Window is missing.
   - The avatar is displayed as a plain image with the username positioned below it.
3. **Incorrect Bottom Control Layout**
   - Four buttons are displayed in a single horizontal row at the bottom:
     - `麦克风`
     - `结束`
     - `切换`
     - `摄像头`
   - The `切换` button is displayed even though it is not part of the expected camera-off layout.
4. **Incorrect Button Labels**
   - `结束` is displayed instead of `挂断`.
   - `麦克风` is displayed instead of `麦克风已开`.
   - `摄像头` is displayed instead of `摄像头已关`.
   - The expected `扬声器已开` button is not displayed.
5. **Incorrect Background**
   - The current interface displays a solid dark gray background without the expected soft blur effect.
   - ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aab98157e0db69f0ab5152c/attachments/6ab21297826ff09d0ec6bf57/previews/6ab21298826ff09d0ec6bf89/download/image.webp)

**Expected:**

When the camera is turned off during an active video call, the Caller and Receiver should display the same camera-off interface according to the expected `接通-关闭摄像头-双方界面一样` layout:

1. **Top Action Icons**
   - Magic Wand/Filter icon should be displayed on the upper-right.
   - Camera Switch icon should be displayed on the upper-right.
2. **Video and Avatar Layout**
   - One large floating video preview window should be displayed on the right side.
   - One smaller Avatar Window should be displayed in the center.
3. **Bottom Control Layout**
   - **Top row:** 3 buttons:
     - Left: `麦克风已开`
     - Center: `扬声器已开`
     - Right: `摄像头已关`
   - **Bottom row:** 1 centered red button:
     - `挂断`
4. **Background**
   - A soft blurred background overlay should be displayed.
5. **Caller and Receiver Consistency**
   - Both parties should use the same camera-off interface and layout.
   - ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aab98157e0db69f0ab5152c/attachments/6ab2125c45599cb4737bf1b0/previews/6ab2125d45599cb4737bf296/download/image.webp)

Account: [yinox41934@art2mart.com](mailto:yinox41934@art2mart.com "‌")

Password: 001224

Build Version:9.22.1.11

Device Version: Android 14
Device Modal: POCO X5 Pro 5G

On the Betting History screen (accessed via Withdraw → Betting History), the page displays a row of provider tabs (RR, PG, PP, JILI, JDB, MG, T1, EVO, ShaBa, CMD) intended to filter the bet list by game provider. When switching between tabs, the underlying data does not change — the same set of bets (identical Bet Numbers, Times, Bet Amounts, and Profit Amounts) is shown regardless of which provider is selected. This suggests the tab/filter selection isn't being sent to the backend correctly, or the API is hardcoded to return only RR-provider results.

Step by Step:

1. Log in and navigate to Withdraw → Betting History
2. Set the Transaction Time filter to "Today"
3. Note the transaction list shown under the default "RR" tab
4. Click through the other provider tabs: PG, PP, JILI, JDB, MG, T1, EVO, ShaBa, CMD
5. Compare the Time / Bet Number / Bet Amount / Profit Amount columns across tabs
6. Repeat steps 2–5 with the Transaction Time filter set to "1 Month"
7. Repeat steps 2–5 with the Transaction Time filter set to "Yesterday"

Results:

Under the "Today" and "1 Month" time filters, all provider tabs return identical data — the same Bet Numbers and amounts as the RR tab (e.g. 20019523981, 20019523923, 20019523865, 20019523798, 20019523730...) appear no matter which provider tab is selected.

**Note:** The "Yesterday" filter is not affected — tab filtering works correctly and returns the expected provider-specific data. The issue appears isolated to the "Today" and "1 Month" time filters.

Expectations:

Each provider tab should filter and display only the bets placed on games from that specific provider, regardless of the selected time range.
cards.name: 0202_99v7 : Withdraw > Betting History_09/24/2026_Betting History tab filter not working — all provider tabs show RR data only

### Account: **+8615151112222/+86151113333**

Password:  **aC1234**
Device: Vivo1904/V2036
Device Version: Android 11/Android 13
Build Version: v8.9.21.1.1

**Steps:**

- Install and Open the app
- Login in any method
- Go to Message
- Initiate a voice call
- Answer the incoming call on the Receiver device.
- Once the call is connected and enters the `正在通话中` state, check the active call screen on both devices.
- Compare the layout, timer position, status text, icons, button labels, and background styling with the expected `接通-双方界面一样` design.

**Result**

The Active Call Screen on both the **Receiver and Caller sides** does not match the expected layout:

1. **Top Action Icons Missing**
   - The Minimize icon on the upper-left is missing.
   - The Magic Wand and Camera icons on the upper-right are missing.
2. **Incorrect Call Timer Position**
   - The timer (e.g., `02:05` / `02:06`) is displayed below the username instead of at the top center.
3. **Missing Call Status**
   - The `正在通话中` status text is not displayed.
4. **Incorrect Button Labels**
   - Left button displays `麦克风` instead of `麦克风已开`.
   - Center button displays `结束` instead of `挂断`.
   - Right button displays `扬声器` instead of the corresponding speaker state label.
5. **Background and Avatar Styling**
   - The background and avatar presentation do not match the expected design.
   - The background does not have the expected blurred neutral appearance, and the avatar/background styling is particularly inconsistent on the Receiver side.
   - ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aab981fecb7581133aee8d5/attachments/6ab21443781a646e21b61c82/previews/6ab21444781a646e21b61d32/download/image.webp)

**Expected:**

The Active Call Screen should follow the expected `接通-双方界面一样` layout:

1. **Top Action Icons**
   - A Minimize icon should be displayed on the upper-left.
   - Magic Wand and Camera icons should be displayed on the upper-right.
2. **Call Timer**
   - The call timer (e.g., `01:14:25`) should be positioned at the **top center** of the screen.
3. **Call Status**
   - `正在通话中` should be displayed below the user's name.
4. **Button Labels**
   - Left: `麦克风已开`
   - Center: `挂断`
   - Right: `扬声器已关` or `扬声器已开`, depending on the current speaker state.
5. **Background and Avatar**
   - A blurred, neutral background should be displayed.
   - The user's avatar should use the expected clean square styling.
   - ![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aab981fecb7581133aee8d5/attachments/6ab214acca8a4e15f7bb0a19/previews/6ab214acca8a4e15f7bb0af2/download/image.webp)

In the multi-platform voice/live room ("连麦厅"), when a host invites a user to a mic seat, the invited user's avatar should display an "邀请中..." (Inviting...) status label until the invite is accepted or expires. This works correctly on Web, iOS, and the Host (anchor) view, but on Android the badge area renders empty — no text is shown — while the invite is pending. This creates an inconsistent experience where Android users can't tell that a seat invitation is in progress, potentially leading to confusion or duplicate invite attempts.

Step by Step:

1. Login the account from above
2. From the Home page, select the Video Tab and select “派对 (Party Tab).
3. Join room `test85695连麦厅` from Web, Android, iOS, and the Host/anchor device simultaneously.
4. From the Host device, send a mic-seat invite to a user (seat showing "主播 991").
5. Observe the second avatar slot (next to "主播 柒萌_s...") on the Android client while the invite is pending.

Results:

Only the **Android** client shows a blank/empty badge area in that position (see red-boxed empty area in screenshot) — the label text fails to render. Web, iOS, and Host all render it correctly.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aaf552db6f9b2a33914457e/attachments/6ab4c73b34309cecf6885b1a/previews/6ab4c73c34309cecf6885cd8/download/image.webp)

Expectations:

While an invite is pending, the Android client should display the "邀请中..." (Inviting...) label on the invited user's avatar, matching Web, iOS, and Host.

Step by Step:

### Preconditions

1. The device is not in Silent Mode.
2. Device ringtone/media volume is turned up.
3. Caller and recipient accounts are logged in.
4. Both users are able to make and receive calls.

### Steps to Reproduce

**Incoming Call:**

1. Log in as User A on Device A.
2. Log in as User B on Device B.
3. From User A, initiate a call to User B.
4. Observe Device B while the call is incoming.
5. Check whether an incoming call ringtone is played.

**Outgoing Call:**

1. From User B, initiate a call to User A.
2. Observe the caller's device while the call is connecting/ringing.
3. Check whether an outgoing ringback tone is played.

‌

Results:

- The recipient does not hear an **incoming call ringtone** when receiving a call.
- The caller does not hear an **outgoing ringback tone** while waiting for the recipient to answer.
- The issue occurs even when the device is **not on Silent Mode** and the volume is set to an audible level.

‌

Expectations:

- The recipient should hear the configured **incoming call ringtone** when receiving a call.
- The caller should hear the **outgoing ringback/ringing tone** while the call is being established.
- Ringtone behavior should work normally when the device is not on Silent Mode.
cards.name: 0008_[99000/99001/992266 White : Features - Voice And Video Call] [9/15/2026] No Incoming or Outgoing Call Ringtone Even When Device Is Not on Silent Mode

### Description

Account:-- 19900999812

Password:-- qweqe

Build Version: v4.8.9.14.1.1

Device Version: Redmi 9T Android 12

Step by Step:

1. Install and open game 99 apps
2. Log in as guest or an account
3. Play a multiple games first to record a recently played games
4. Navigate to the **Recently Played Games** page.
5. Tap the first game, for example **Mahjong Ways 2**.
6. Wait for the game to open successfully.
7. Return to the **Recently Played Games** page while the first game session is still active.
8. Tap another game, for example **Tsar Treasures**.
9. Observe the behavior.
10. Repeat the process with additional games such as **Mahjong Ways 3** and **Anubis Wrath**.

‌

### Actual Result

Multiple games can be opened from the **Recently Played Games** page while previous game sessions are still active. The user is able to launch different games consecutively without the previous game session being properly closed or terminated.

‌

‌

‌

Two UI stability/interaction issues were reported in the app:

1. Activity section crash: when a user opens an event in Activity and taps the Back button rapidly multiple times, the app crashes instead of handling the navigation safely. Repro details include Android 9 on Oppo A12, build 9.15.1.1, guest login, and a video link: [https://drive.google.com/file/d/1L5A_4kifMeg3HnibVduzmG1pz3ShWTRN/view?usp=drive_link](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1L5A_4kifMeg3HnibVduzmG1pz3ShWTRN/view?usp=drive_link).

2. Game section keyboard overlap: in Lottery game > 香港六合彩 > 特码, when the on-screen keyboard appears, the "单注" input field and the "添加注单" button do not move above the keyboard and become covered. Repro details include Android 10 on VIVO y52s and build v4.9.15.1.1.

Both issues are visual/interaction bugs affecting usability and should be fixed so navigation and input fields behave correctly on mobile devices.

### Description

Account: +6285213634216 | [kijotek782@blobapps.com](mailto:kijotek782@blobapps.com "‌")

Password: 001226 | 001224

Build Version: v8.9.19.1.11

Device Version: Android 9/14

Device Modal: Vivo Y17/POCO X5 Pro 5G

When a user selects a new avatar from the **Change Avatar** picker and taps **Confirm**, the app reports success (toast: "Profile Picture Updated") but the avatar image is not reliably applied. Depending on the attempt, the result is one of: the avatar frame stays completely empty, it renders a mismatched/incorrect image (unrelated to the selection, e.g. a winter/scene graphic instead of the chosen portrait), or the home/lobby screen shows a different (and sometimes still wrong) image than the Profile screen.

Step by Step:

- Login via guest/email/phone
- Open **Personal Center** (Profile).
- Tap the avatar placeholder to open **Change Avatar**.
- Select an avatar from the grid.
- Tap **Confirm**.
- Observe the avatar frame on the Profile screen and the "Profile Picture Updated" toast.
- Navigate to the home/lobby screen and check the avatar indicator there.
- Repeat steps 2–4 with a different avatar selection, and try reopening the **Change Avatar** dialog a second time.

Results:

- Avatar frame remains blank after confirmation, despite a "Profile Picture Updated" success toast (most common outcome, seen in 2nd recording).
- In some attempts, a mismatched image renders instead of the selected avatar (seen in 1st recording, and on the home/lobby screen in the 2nd).
- The home/lobby avatar indicator does not consistently reflect the confirmed selection.
- Reopening the **Change Avatar** dialog can momentarily show an empty avatar grid before thumbnails populate.

![image.webp](https://trello.com/1/cards/6aab97da31b8e78b214b986b/attachments/6ab1f95952165d5bca4428a7/previews/6ab1f95a52165d5bca4428fe/download/image.webp)

Expectations:

- After confirming, the avatar frame on the Profile screen should display exactly the avatar image selected in the grid.
- The selected avatar should persist and display consistently across other screens (e.g., home/lobby).
- The **Change Avatar** dialog should reliably show all avatar thumbnails each time it's opened.
cards.name: 0142_9906 : Personal Center → Change Avatar_09/22/2026_Avatar does not update correctly after selection in "Change Avatar" dialog
